purpose: Acknowledgement polling with geometric backoff and fail-safe receipt handling.
overview: ackpoll.go polls delivery receipts to a terminal state under the wait ceiling, backs off geometrically, and treats vanished receipts as failures so a lost receipt can never silently drop a page.

1| package notify
2| 
3| import "time"
4| 
5| // awaitAck polls the provider's receipt endpoint until the delivery
6| // reaches a terminal state. Polling backs off geometrically from the
7| // initial interval; a receipt that vanishes from the provider's side
8| // is treated as failed, never as delivered, because a lost receipt
9| // after a real delivery re-pages harmlessly while the reverse drops
10| // a page.
11| func (n *Notifier) awaitAck(r Receipt) error {
12| 	interval := n.pollInitial
13| 	deadline := n.clock.Now().Add(n.waitCeiling)
14| 	for n.clock.Now().Before(deadline) {
15| 		state, err := n.provider.Receipt(r)
16| 		if err == nil && state.Terminal() {
17| 			if state.Delivered() {
18| 				return nil
19| 			}
20| 			return errDeliveryFailed
21| 		}
22| 		n.clock.Sleep(interval)
23| 		interval = n.nextInterval(interval)
24| 	}
25| 	return errAckTimeout
26| }
